title: Local lifts for an epimorphism of etale sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, let $\Lambda$ be a ring, and let $0\to\mathcal M\to\mathcal E\xrightarrow{\pi}\mathcal N\to0$ be a short exact sequence of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every etale $X$-scheme $U$ and every section $t\in\mathcal N(U)$, there is an etale covering $(U_i\to U)_i$ and sections $s_i\in\mathcal E(U_i)$ with $\pi(s_i)=t|_{U_i}$.

source.place: ## Proof, extension paragraph: a surjection of sheaves is locally surjective on sections

proof.text: The displayed sequence is short exact, so its right-hand map $\pi$ is an epimorphism in the abelian category of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules, by [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

source.place: ## Proof, extension paragraph: a surjection of sheaves is locally surjective on sections

proof.text: The forgetful functor from sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ (sheaves of modules over the constant sheaf of rings $\Lambda_X$) to the category $\Ab(X_{\Et})$ of abelian sheaves is exact, in particular it preserves cokernels, by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] (1) (the small etale site admits sheafification of abelian presheaves). Since $\pi$ is an epimorphism, $\operatorname{Coker}\pi=0$ in sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules, hence the cokernel of the underlying map of abelian sheaves is $0$, so $\pi$ is an epimorphism of $\Ab(X_{\Et})$.

source.place: ## Proof, extension paragraph: a surjection of sheaves is locally surjective on sections

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective] to $\pi:\mathcal E\to\mathcal N$, an epimorphism of $\Ab(X_{\Et})$ by the previous step. For the given etale object $U$ and section $t\in\mathcal N(U)$, it supplies an etale covering $(U_i\to U)_i$ and sections $s_i\in\mathcal E(U_i)$ such that $\pi(s_i)=t|_{U_i}$ for every $i$.
